sentences.en: Condoms are barrier contraceptives made from latex rubber or a very thin plastic called polyurethane.

sentences.en: The authors set out to identify whether levetiracetam, the newest of the anti-epileptic drugs, influences the pharmacokinetics of steroid oral contraceptives.

sentences.en: Primarily a pustular rash may also be seen in those taking corticosteroids, lithium, oral contraceptives and anticonvulsant therapies.
